information.full_truth: also knows undisclosed soft truth; legal graph still requires disclosed hard fields
information.full_truth_free_hard: also supplies free hard disclosure on arrival for every actor with no permanent hard decline; altered information/query cost, same constraints and legal graph checks; no future outcome draw access
information.known_parameter_missing: knows true actor bias/second_bias/response propensity and family; missing soft equalities integrated uniformly; ignores feedback posterior for missing features
information.observation_prior: disclosed JSON observations and fixed public family prior only; current-greedy scoring; numerical15-node quadrature may differ from frozen5-node candidate

limitations: A stronger informational level can have worse realized reward, and greedy full-truth score need not optimize dynamic value. Expected current-edge probabilities summed on adaptively chosen observed trajectories are a diagnostic; sample averaging has only5 clusters. Action changes move pair/day hash streams, so downstream common random numbers are incomplete. No policy sees future arrivals, exits, schedules, pair Gaussian or Bernoulli draws.
scope: privileged diagnostic policies, old1001--1005 five seed clusters x6 families x4 levels; exploratory; not candidate selection, deployable performance, or dynamic upper bounds
